item.question: How do audience expectations influence engagement with stories?
item.answer: Audience expectations about how a story might unfold play a significant role in their engagement decisions. By modeling these forward-looking beliefs, content creators can better understand the factors that drive continued reading, commenting, and voting on narrative media.
